Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: Every control can be reached with Tab in a logical order
evidence: Skip links, screen links, help, night mode, charts in reading order (each after its own buttons), then the filter panel

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: Focus always visible (focus-visible, never outline: none without replacement)
evidence: 3 px outline on every control (white on the dark header band); white and blue SVG ring on every chart stop, in both themes

evidence: C1-C3 (hotel), C4 (hotel dot of the same country)

evidence: Each chart has its own polite live region

evidence: Other series at opacity 0.4 while the focus is in the chart, restored when it leaves

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: The selected category and its exact value are always visible next to the chart
evidence: "Selected month" and "Selected country" boxes; value box next to the focused mark

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: Navigation controls fit on a phone
evidence: The dashboard is for a computer or a tablet (architecture.md): designed for a 16:9 screen and checked down to a 768 px wide tablet

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: The SVG focus indicator is drawn in its own group above the marks (correct z-order)

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: The focus group is cleared on blur

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: The focus announces its position and scrolls the element into view

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: Focus on a dark background uses a double ring (3:1, WCAG 2.4.11)
evidence: White and blue double ring on the marks, checked in the night mode too

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: The focused element is not hidden by fixed elements (WCAG 2.4.11)

Operability item (wcag-accessibility ski: Skip link at the start of the page
